name: Scope Nine Alert Bar
author: Abdullah Sajjad

sections.description:
Scope Nine Alert Bar lets you display beautiful, customizable alert bars and notification banners on your WordPress website. Perfect for announcements, promotions, cookie notices, or any site-wide message.

Features

  • Live Preview — See your changes in real-time as you design your alert bar
  • WYSIWYG Editor — Rich text editor with bold, italic, links, and color support
  • Custom Colors — Set background and text colors with hex input or color picker
  • Custom Styling — Add your own CSS for complete design control
  • Close Button — Dismissible alerts with customizable close icon
  • Display Options — Show site-wide, homepage only, or on specific pages/posts
  • Position Control — Place bar before or after the header
  • Responsive Design — Looks great on all devices
  • Padding Control — Fine-tune spacing with individual top/right/bottom/left padding
  • Link Posts — Optionally link to any post with custom title and expiry date
  • Modern Admin UI — Clean, intuitive settings page

How It Works

  1. Go to Alert Bar > Design in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter your alert message using the rich text editor
  3. Customize colors, padding, and display options
  4. Save and your alert bar appears on your site instantly

Link a Post (Optional)

You can also link the alert bar to any post:

  1. Edit the post you want to feature
  2. In the “Alert Bar” meta box, check “Feature in Alert Bar”
  3. Optionally set a custom title and expiry date
  4. The alert bar will display with a link to that post
sections.installation:
1. Upload the scope-nine-alert-bar folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Alert Bar > Design to configure your alert bar
sections.faq:
Can I show the bar only on certain pages?

Yes! In the Display On setting, choose “Specific Pages Only” and select which pages and posts should display the alert bar.

Can I use HTML in the alert message?

Yes, the WYSIWYG editor supports bold, italic, underline, links, and text color formatting.

How do I add custom styling?

Use Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS (classic themes) or the Site Editor’s Additional CSS (block themes). The alert bar uses .scopenine-alert-bar class and the close button uses .scopenine-alert-bar-close.

Is the alert bar responsive?

Yes, the alert bar is fully responsive and adapts to all screen sizes.
